name: io.github.tillbooks/tillbooks
title: TILL
description: Agent-first open-source ERP for Swiss SMEs: 822 MCP tools, one local file.

packageArguments.description: Start the TILL MCP server on stdio (the agent interface).

environmentVariables.name: TILL_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to your TILL SQLite ledger. Leave unset for the default (~/.till/till.db); TILL bundles no database.

environmentVariables.name: TILL_SUPPORT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where TILL keeps machine-scoped state (diagnostics, backups). Leave unset for the default (~/.till).
